name: Ethical Hacker
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Ethical Hacker course. The holder of this student level credential has a broad understanding of the legal and compliance requirements and is proficient in the art of scoping, executing, reporting vulnerability assessments, and recommending mitigation strategies. The holder has completed up to 34 hands-on activities using Kali Linux, WebSploit, and other tools..

name: Diploma in Computer Networking
description: Comprehensive course covering network protocols, architecture, and administration.

name: Diploma in Application Development (PHP & MySQL)
description: Software & Development certification focused on backend application development using PHP and MySQL databases.

name: Professional Diploma in Web Design & Development
description: Professional program covering modern web design practices and structural development methodologies.

name: Angular Certificate
description: Frontend framework certification for single-page application development.

name: Java Certificate
description: Core object-oriented programming concepts and application architecture in Java.

name: SQL, JavaScript, HTML & CSS Certificates
description: Foundational web and data development stack certifications covering structural, behavioral, and database query technologies.

name: CompTIA A+
description: DevOps and IT foundational certification covering hardware, operating systems, and fundamental operational troubleshooting.

name: Introduction to Modern AI
description: Cisco verifies the earner of this badge successfully completed the Introduction to Modern AI course. The learner will have practiced using AI enabled features on free apps, such as photo apps, translation services, and chatbots. They will have had in depth practice in prompting a chatbot, and understand fundamentals of how the models work, which informs how they prompt chatbots.
